title: Electrolux — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Electrolux.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Shape Living for the Better." Premium tier. Electrolux is the Swedish appliance giant — the parent company behind Frigidaire, Frigidaire Gallery, and Frigidaire Professional. The Electrolux brand itself sits at the premium tier with Scandinavian design and industry-leading fabric care. Their SmartBoost premixing technology dissolves detergent before it touches clothes — Consumer Reports consistently rates Electrolux washers best for stain removal. The Air Sous Vide wall oven feature is completely unique to the brand.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Customers who care about laundry results above all else. Design-forward buyers who appreciate Scandinavian aesthetic. Cooking enthusiasts excited by Air Sous Vide.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Electrolux:

• SmartBoost premixes water, detergent, and oxygen before touching clothes — best stain removal in the industry

• Air Sous Vide in wall ovens — only brand that does precision low-temp cooking built into the oven

• 15-minute fast wash on dishwashers — fastest in the market for quick loads

• LuxCare wash system with optimal water temperature throughout the entire cycle

• Perfect Steam dryer removes wrinkles without an iron — saves time and looks professional
